reuse.why: Uses getAverageFillCategories for category selection, spendingToBudgetAmount for the sign, getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages, exactly like set3MonthAvg.

duplication.why: Only the small batch/loop/setBudget skeleton shared by all month-wide actions is repeated; the selection and sign rules are not copied.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Action, handler registration, one test and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A short action composed entirely from the existing shared helpers, so rule changes to selection or sign apply automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection and sign go through getAverageFillCategories/shouldFillCategory and spendingToBudgetAmount.
